_comment: Production registration for the Kementerian Pertahanan Republik Indonesia (Kemhan) Berita source family.
This is a MANUAL source: public Daily never fetches www.kemhan.go.id.

public corpus through this manifest. Registering the source gives it the same registry
row, run-result row and liveness disposition as every other production source.
